en: Black‑and‑white street view of a small European town, likely around the turn of the 20th century. People in period clothing, including women with long dresses and children, stand and walk along a broad unpaved street lined with two‑ and three‑storey masonry houses with steep tiled roofs. On the right, a large painted wall advertisement for a bakery is visible; in the background rises a sizable baroque‑style church or town‑hall tower with a domed cupola and lantern. The scene has the character of an old photographic postcard of a German town.
